name: Prepare speech
description: Gets the venue's speech engine ready before any audio or text is in hand: to transcribe (the default) or, with for: speak, to speak. The local engine fetches that direction's pinned model and its native libraries once, if they are not yet on this machine, and loads the libraries; that can take minutes, and speech:engines reports the download's progress meanwhile. A remote engine needs nothing. Returns the engines as speech:engines reports them.

for.description: Which direction to get ready; transcribe by default.
